notes: Floating sluice counterweight hand: wrist cuff (the crystal seat), a weight block with a lifting slot, a hooked thumb (toward the body) and two curled clamp fingers. Drawn as the screen-right hand; mirror it for the left. Anchor = bottom centre of the clamp (the slam contact point). clenched / open: hovering bob (open = the clamp spread flat on the floor, used kneeling and dormant). open_lit: the lifting slot fills with iris light (charging the beam). slam: 0 rise (lifted 9, slot starting to fill), 1 wind-up hold (lifted 23 and stretched 3, slot blazing = the telegraph), 2 falling (lifted 3, stretched 5, streaks), 3 impact squash 6 px, clamp pressed flat, with stone chips (spawn the shockwave here), 4 recover. The lifts are baked in and cancelled by the runtime; keep the fist anchor on the slam target for the whole anim.
